QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

Made for getting the work done.

Is Boplo an AI essay writer?

No. Boplo helps teams plan, organise, review, and improve their own work. It is designed to make students better collaborators—not replace their thinking.

How does Boplo make group work fairer?

It gives every task, section, source, and review a clear owner. The contribution view recognises research, writing, feedback, and coordination—not just the person who typed the most words.

Can we use it with our existing tools?

Yes. Boplo is designed to organise the project around your existing work, whether you are starting from a brief, a shared document, or notes from your first meeting.

Is it free for students?

Yes. Students can start a project for free. Advanced quality reviews and unlimited projects will be available with Boplo Pro.
